title: Sunday, or a Deal

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: Heavy going: the US weighs a Sunday strike on Iran or a deal, Houthis hit Saudi Arabia and Aden, 2,000 flee Hebron, a Tibet quake kills 16. Small lifts: Vanuatu's tsunami warning lifted, Brazil votes peacefully, Bennu's samples give up new findings.

France marches for the price of bread,

and dust from Bennu, older than us,
